description: Pick the pieces that qualify as samples (listed at $20 or under, under 7 inches overall, not a made-to-order line) from a plan or from given variant ids, and return a cart link with one of each plus the sample terms. Samples are bought at the normal price; after the full order the shopper emails both order numbers to orders@knobs.co and up to two samples they did not choose are credited back. Pieces that do not qualify are returned with the reason.

plan_url.description: the plan_url from build_plan: samples are taken from that plan

variant_ids.description: or specific variant ids to check for sample eligibility (give plan_url or variant_ids, not both)
